entries.rationale: Additive optional flag with a fully pinned contract (D2: stdout regex, exit codes, error codes, ordering). One source file plus one test, same-function precedent in --blocker-id. Mechanical and cheaply revertible.

Additive optional flag forwarded to writeHeuristic, which already accepts signature. Spec-implied rather than spec-named (D10), so validate will raise a scope-expansion sub-finding; rationale is on record. Single file, mechanical.

Extract a string literal into prefixFor(); body given verbatim and PASS output stays byte-identical. Blast held at 0.8 because it edits a live non-blocking Stop hook that runs on every validate run, not because the change is large.

Implements the identifiers-only security boundary in a live Stop hook. Captured text is git-tracked and /adev:sync copies it into four agent files, so a widened read set leaks outward. Checkpoint after RED: confirm no field beyond checks[].id/outcome is read.

Mirrors Task 3 into the harness the PASS suite actually asserts against. Total 16 clears auto, but tier full is recommended: the two copies are deliberately unshared (D9) and divergence is silent, since no PASS test invokes the hook.

Byte-identity is the acceptance bar but PRE_CHANGE_FIXTURE names no file and no capture procedure; captured after a partial edit the assertion is vacuous. Checkpoint that the fixture came from unmodified code before SKILL.md is touched.

Deletes a verb, a flag, deriveId, a check file and 27 test references across lib/, tests/ and skills/, and falsifies a criterion in another charter's spec. Deletion is not cheaply revertible and the 'if they lose their last caller' helper list is left to implementer judgement.

Mechanical edits, but they span docs/, lib/diagnostics/ and a spec owned by a different charter, and the supersede annotation has no prescribed wording. Total 15 lands just under auto; the review that matters is the cross-spec line only.
